auth.name: Your name
auth.codeSent: We sent a code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.tagline: Record sessions, check the transcript, approve the session note.

consent.title: Consent

agree.recording: I agree to the audio recording.
agree.ai_processing: I agree to the AI processing.
agree.product_improvement: I agree to the use for product improvement.

consent.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw consent to {{kind}}? Recording stops being possible and audio that has not been processed yet will be deleted.

recovery.message: A recording with {{name}} ({{time}}) was interrupted. The audio saved so far is safe on this device.

sessions.chooseClient: Choose the client. Only clients who have given consent can be recorded.
sessions.offlineList: Offline: showing the consent status last saved on this device.

record.hint: Audio is encrypted on this device and uploaded in the background. Recording continues without internet.
record.savedLocally: Saved encrypted on this device every 10 seconds.
record.uploading: Uploading in the background ({{count}} parts left). You can close this screen.
record.otherActive: Another recording is running. Stop it first.

problem.unsupported: This browser cannot record audio. Please use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
problem.mic_denied: No access to the microphone. Please allow microphone access in the browser settings.
problem.mic_lost: The microphone was disconnected. Recording has no sound. Reconnect it, stop and start a new recording.
problem.storage_low: Not enough free storage on this device (at least 500 MB needed). Free up space, then try again.
problem.storage_full: The device storage is full. The recording was stopped; everything saved so far is kept.
problem.write_failed: Audio could not be saved on this device. The recording was stopped; everything saved so far is kept.

dock.label: Running recording
dock.continues: The recording continues in the background.

record.signOutConfirm: A recording is running. Stop it and sign out? Everything recorded so far is kept and uploads after the next sign-in.

mic.unavailable: Voice detection is not available in this browser.
mic.silenceWarning: No speech picked up for 2 minutes. Check the microphone.
mic.switchHint: To switch now, stop and start a new recording.

test.title: Test the microphone
test.hint: Before your first recording on this device, press the button and say a few words.
test.failed: No speech picked up. Check the microphone and try again.

session.title: Session on {{date}}
session.waitingForUpload: Waiting for the rest of the audio from the recording device ({{done}} of {{total}} parts). Open the app on that device so it can finish uploading.
session.transcribingHint: Usually ready within a minute. You can leave this page; the transcript will be here when it is ready.

failure.incomplete_upload: Parts of the recording are missing, so it could not be transcribed. Open the app on the recording device to finish the upload.
failure.chunk_corrupt: Part of the recording is damaged and could not be decrypted.
failure.transcription_failed: The transcription service did not respond. Please try again.
failure.no_speech: No speech was found in the recording.
failure.key_missing: The key for this recording is missing, so it cannot be decrypted.
failure.audio_not_accepted: The audio of this session is no longer available.
failure.consent_missing: Consent for this client was withdrawn, so the session was not transcribed.
failure.unknown: The session could not be transcribed.

session.finishingHint: Most of the session was transcribed during recording. Finishing the last part…

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.speaker: Speaker {{label}}
transcript.whoHint: The transcript separates voices but does not know who is who. Choose your voice; everyone else is shown as the client.
transcript.reviewNote: Automatic transcript. It can contain mistakes — please check before using it.
transcript.checking: Checking who said what against the whole session… This takes a few minutes; speaker labels may still change.
transcript.checked: Speakers checked against the whole session.
transcript.correctHint: Wrong speaker? Click the name to switch it, or swap both speakers from a line on.
transcript.swapFromLabel: Swap therapist and client from {{time}} on

live.title: Transcript so far
live.hint: Live text on this device is a rough preview and stays on this device. The transcript with speakers comes from the server, about a minute behind.
live.empty: Nothing transcribed yet. The first part appears after about a minute.
live.loading: Loading the speech model ({{percent}} %). Only the first time on this device.
live.turnOff: Turn off live preview on this device
live.turnOn: Turn on live preview on this device

status.too_slow: Live preview paused: this device is too slow. The server transcript continues.
status.error: Live preview could not start. The server transcript continues.
status.unsupported: This browser cannot run the live preview. The server transcript continues.
status.language: Live preview is not available for this language yet. The server transcript continues.
status.off: Live preview is off on this device. The server transcript continues.

live.listening: Listening. Words appear here as they are spoken.

captures.title: Notes from the session
captures.hint: Suggested from the transcript and your bookmarks. Keep what is useful; kept notes are used for the report.

report.title: Session note

prompts.mental_status: Only if something changed. "No change" is fine.
prompts.progress: Progress, setback or standstill; motivation; difficulties.
prompts.crisis: Only if addressed. Nothing is written here automatically.
prompts.notable: Medication changes, contact with other professionals, missed sessions…

report.aiDraftHint: Check every sentence against the transcript. The AI only writes what was said; it does not assess.
report.therapistPartHint: These fields are never filled by the AI.

flagHints.partly: The transcript supports only part of this sentence.
flagHints.unsupported: This sentence could not be matched to the transcript.
flagHints.wording: Judgmental or emotion words. The client can read this note (§630g BGB).
flagHints.name: The AI used another person's name. Notes should name roles (partner, boss); the client can read the note.

report.regenerateAllConfirm: Draft all AI fields again? Your changes to those fields will be replaced. Your clinical part and the session details are kept.
report.blocking_one: {{count}} AI sentence still needs your check (keep, edit or delete).
report.blocking_other: {{count}} AI sentences still need your check (keep, edit or delete).
report.approveHint: After approval the note can no longer be changed; later changes are added as dated addenda.
report.approveConfirm: Approve this note? It can no longer be changed afterwards.
report.sourceHint: Click a line to find the sentence based on it.
report.draftingHint: Usually takes less than a minute.
report.startHint: Let the AI draft the note from the transcript and your notes, or write it yourself.
report.needsTranscript: The AI draft needs the finished transcript.
report.noConsent: The client has not consented to AI processing (or has withdrawn it). Please write the note yourself.

failure.drafting_failed: The AI service did not respond. Please try again or write the note yourself.
failure.llm_not_configured: AI drafting is not set up yet. Please write the note yourself.
failure.decryption_failed: The transcript could not be read.
failure.unknown: The draft could not be written.

report.footerAi: Drafted with AI assistance; reviewed and approved by the therapist.

reports.noneHint: A session note appears here once you approve it. Drafts stay with their session.

hiddenNames.title: Names hidden from the AI
hiddenNames.hint: Names of other people the client talks about (partner, children, employer…). They are replaced by placeholders before the transcript is sent for AI drafting. The client's and your own name are always hidden.

notifications.empty: No notifications yet. You will see here when a transcript or a note draft is ready.
notifications.notesToReview_one: {{count}} note draft is waiting for your review.
notifications.notesToReview_other: {{count}} note drafts are waiting for your review.

kinds.report_no_consent: No AI consent – write the note yourself

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: Shown only on your own screens. Clients never see it.
avatar.illustratedHint: Animated. Reacts to what the app is doing, never to what is said.
avatar.photoHint: A still photo of you. Stored encrypted; you can remove it at any time.
avatar.tilt: Tilt the photo slightly toward the pointer
avatar.prepareFailed: This image could not be opened. Please choose another one.

crop.title: Crop the photo
crop.hint: Drag to move the photo. The circle shows what is kept.

avatar.characterHint: Pick one of three illustrated characters.
avatar.drawnHint: An animated drawing that looks like you, made from a photo. The photo is not stored.

editor.title: Your drawn avatar
editor.suggested: Suggested from your photo. Check it and change anything that is not right.
editor.privacy: The photo is sent once to Google Gemini to suggest the drawing, then discarded. Only the drawing is saved.

reactions.title: Avatar during recordings
reactions.nod: Short glance when a new note appears in the live transcript
reactions.hint: Off by default and only on your screen. The avatar never reacts to what is said or how anyone sounds.

device.title: Recording on this device
device.hint: These settings apply only to this browser.
device.recordSounds: Play a short sound when a recording starts and stops
device.livePreview: Show the live transcript during recordings
device.livePreload: Load the live transcript model when the app opens (about 155 MB, once)
device.livePreloadHint: Without it, the model loads when you start a recording and the first words appear later.

preload.loading: Loading the live transcript model ({{percent}} %). Only needed once on this device.
preload.failed: The live transcript model could not be loaded. It will be tried again next time; recording works without it.

setup.title: Set up your keys
setup.intro: Signed session notes are encrypted so that only you can read them. Your key is created on this device and protected with a passphrase. Sessio never sees the passphrase.
setup.passphraseHint: At least {{n}} characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
setup.noReset: Sessio cannot reset a forgotten passphrase.
setup.tooShort: The passphrase needs at least {{n}} characters.
setup.mismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
setup.recoveryIntro: If you forget your passphrase, the recovery key is the only way to open your signed records. It is shown only now. Keep the file safe and offline, for example on a USB stick in a locked cabinet.
setup.downloaded: Open the downloaded file. Near the top is a line with the check code.
setup.checkWrong: This check code does not match. Open the file you saved and type the code shown there.

status.title: Your key
status.unlockedHint: Your key is unlocked on this device. It locks after 15 minutes without activity and when you close the tab.
status.lockedHint: Unlock your key to sign session notes and open signed ones.

details.title: Key details
details.fingerprintHint: Fingerprints identify your keys. Compare them if you ever use a key outside Sessio.
details.forgotten: If you forget your passphrase, only the recovery key can open your signed records. Restoring access with it comes in a later version.
